senses.gloss:
Kukavisantāpana
by Ghanaśyāma (1715-50 A. D.); of the Tanjore Mahratta Court; mentioned a. a separate work of a. by his wives Kamalā an. Sundarī in their C. on Viddhasālabhañjikā (Introductory verse); but it is only the 4th Act of a.'s Ḍamaruka.

Kukkācārya
Q. by Haribhadrasūri. Jain. (middle of 8th Cent. A. D.). See Gode, Stud. in Ind. Lit. His.. I. p. 16 fn.

Kukkuṭakalpa
tantra. (ābhicārika) a.. TCD. 1925B. Tra. Ad. Rep. 1108. 14 (inc.). Trav. Uni. C. 2240B (inc.).

Kukkuṭamantra
PUL. II. App. p. 59. See below.

Kukkuṭātantra
a. given in Toḍalatantra; q. by Sarvānandanātha in Sarvollāsa (RASB. VIII. A. 6204). C.. below Kukkuṭeśvaratantra.

Kukkuṭīvrata
with Kathā. Dacca 554. A. 10. [Page172-a. 1010. O. 3. 45. A. 3811. 690B (inc.). SSPC. I. I. 370 (1) (without Kathā).

Kukkuṭīvrata
or Lalitāsaptamīvrata. from the Bhaviṣyapurāṇa.
Pt.. in Vratamālā compiled by N. K. Bhattacarya. 1869. See IO. Pt.. Bk.. 1938, p. 1402.

Kukkuṭīvratakathā
Adyar I. p. 169 (a.. BORI. 121 of 1891-95. L. 628. SSPC. I. I. 370 (2). See also previous entry.
--from Bhaviṣyapurāṇa. Vaṅgīya p. 80. See above Ku. vrata from same purāṇa.

Kukkuṭeśvaratantra
Q. in Tantrasāra, Oxf. 95a. mentioned by Raghunātha Tarkavāgīśa, in Āgamatattvavilāsa, L. 3186.

Kukkuripāda(kukurāja,_kukkurarāja,_gururāja).
Bud. one of the 84 Siddhas; a Brahman of Bengal according to Tibetan tradition, who introduced Mahāmāyā cult into Tibet. C. 693 A. D.
--Tattvasukhabhāvanānusāriyogabhāvanopadeśa. Cordier II. p. 240.
--Padmanarteśvaraguhyārthadharavyūha. Cordier II. p. 109.
--Mahāmāyātantrānusāriṇī Herukasādhanopāyikā. Cordier II. p. 102.
--Mahāmāyābalividhi. Cordier III. p. 146.
--Mahāmāyāmaṇḍaladevastotra. Cordier II. p. 103.
--Mahāmāyāsādhanamaṇḍalavidhi. Cordier II. p.. 102-3.
--Mahāmāyāsādhanopāyikā.
Pt.. Sādhanamālā, GOS. XLI. Vol. II. no. 240.
--Mohataraṇakalpa. Cordier II. p. 102.
--Vajraratnaprabhaguhyārthadharavyūha. Cordier II. p. 110. [Page172-b]
--Vajrasattvaguhyārthadharavyūha. Cordier II. p. 109.
--Vajrasattvasādhana. Cordier II. p. 102.
--Vajraherukaguhyārthadharavyūha. Cordier II. p. 109.
--Vairocanaguhyārthadharavyūha. Cordier II. p. 109.
--Sarvabuddhasamayogamaṇḍalavidhi. ibid. p. 110.
--Sarvamaṇḍalānusāreṇa pañcavidhi. ibid. p. 110.
--Sughoṭalalitaguhyārthadharavyūha. ibid. p. 110.
--Sravaparicchedana. Cordier II. p. 240.
For his songs, see Bauddha gān o dohā; also Caryāgītikośa, Visvabharati, 1956, p.. 6, 157.

Kukṣi(vidyā)kalpa
on Ābhicārika. Discusses Kukkuṭeśvaramantra. MT. 4444.

Kukṣimbhara(ri)(bhaikṣava)prahasana
by (Pradhāni) Veṅkaṭabhūpati (or Veṅkaṭācārya) of Bhārgavakula, native of Rāmapura on the banks of Kapini in Mysore; son of Hampāryamantrin an. Vāgāmbikā; a. officer under the Mysore Kings nominally, but actually under Haider Ali from 1763-80 A. D.
Mysore I. p. 275 (3 mss.). Skt. Col.. Mys. 6.
See J. Myth. Soc. XXXI. p. 38.

Kūka
of Kāśyapa gotra, grandson of Govinda surnamed Śukla, son of Vyāsa Nārāyaṇa an. father of Mādhava Śukla (a. of Kuṇḍakalpadruma, d. 1655 A. D., BBRAS. 414.)
